core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamzaa corresponds to the Arabic form حمزة (Arabic root ح م ز (ḥ-m-z); حَمْزَة (Ḥamza)). Its core sense is lion; brave, courageous. Hamzaa is a transliteration of Arabic حَمْزَة (Ḥamza), the name of the Prophet's uncle. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled this form female and glossed it 'protector, defender'; حَمْزَة is a masculine name and the traditional association is with the lion. Same name as hamza and hamzah.

faq.q: What is the origin of Hamzaa?
faq.a: Hamzaa is associated with Arabic. Hamzaa is a transliteration of Arabic حَمْزَة (Ḥamza), the name of the Prophet's uncle. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled this form female and glossed it 'protector, defender'; حَمْزَة is a masculine name and the traditional association is with the lion. Same name as hamza and hamzah.
Yes — the underlying form حمزة is Arabic.
Hamzaa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hamzaa should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Hamzaa mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hamzaa is rendered حمزہ and carries the sense شیر، بہادر.

faq.q: What does Hamzaa mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hamzaa is rendered حمزه and carries the sense شیر، دلیر.
A romanized syllable approximation is ham-zaa. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hamzaa?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hamzaa, hamza, hamzaa. Script forms are حمزة, حمزه, حمزہ, हमज़ा.

faq.q: Is Hamzaa a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
